label: Hickam Composite Squadron
size_basis: estimated typical embroidered patch width 3 in (group, squadron and activity patches 3 in); the official digital artwork carries no physical size; height follows the artwork's own aspect
citation: CAPR 39-1 para 10.9 / Attachment 8 define the patch but give no dimensions
provenance: Official digital artwork of Hickam Composite Squadron (PCR-HI-066), published by Hawaii Wing (hiwg.cap.gov), heraldry page (page https://hiwg.cap.gov/about/heraldry-of-our-units; file address https://hiwg.cap.gov/media/cms/66_D427E0B81CBE6.png); fetched 2026-11-11 and kept unchanged in assets/refs/patches-official/pcr_hi_066/. Shipped as given: the PNG; reduced in size from 6487 x 7259 to 1072 x 1200 px (area average, alpha premultiplied; the long edge is held to 1200 px as the other digital patches are); no redrawing, no tracing, no colour change. Charter: the page lists it under Hickam Composite Squadron, PCR-HI-066; the emblem itself reads HICKAM COMPOSITE SQUADRON and PCR-HI-066; the unit's own site (hi066.cap.gov) is Hickam Composite Squadron, PCR-HI-066 (the builder's unit list calls PCR-HI-066 the 66th Composite Sqdn).
notes: Official digital artwork as given, not a redraw: no thread texture added, nothing re-drawn or re-coloured. The only change is the size, held to 1200 px on the long edge.
